title: Chip substrate makers face 30-month waits for key equipment
html:
Delivery times for some equipment used to manufacture advanced chip substrates have stretched from six months to 30 months as manufacturers race to expand production to meet surging demand for artificial intelligence (AI) chips.

Ushio's lithography equipment for advanced IC package substrates. Credit: Ushio
